'''Darnella Shoran''' is the innkeeper of The [[Golden Swans of Heaven]], in [[Ebou Dar]].

==Activities==
She is a very strict innkeeper. She chides [[Bethamin Zeami]] for having a man in her room, despite the fact that the [[Almurat Mor|man]] was a [[Seanchan]] [[Seekers for Truth|seeker]].
